newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch, Japan to step up technological cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Dutch, Japan to step up technological cooperation.

text.p: Japan's Foreign Affairs Minister Yukihiko Ikeda and his Dutch counterpart Hans van Mierlo signed an agreement on Tuesday to promote bilateral cooperation in science and technology, the Dutch ministry said.
It said the Japanese government has set up programmes for cooperation pacts between Japanese and foreign companies to stimulate research and development.
Because of the treaty, which was signed in Tokyo where Van Mierlo and Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok are on an official visit, Dutch firms will also be able to participate in these programmes.
The agreement also enables Dutch universities and research centres to expand their R&D cooperation with their Japanese counterparts.
The ministry said that, although the Dutch economy is less knowledge-intensive than Japan's there is more demand from Japan for Dutch know-how than the other way around.

The agreement offers a good starting point to jointly approach challenges in the areas of energy, the environment, transport, construction and bio-medical developments, the Dutch ministry said in a statement.
